notes.title: Minor patch 1.0.121
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, While we're busy working on bigger updates, we've decided to release a small patch. Here's a list of changes we made:


 Various atmospheric background sounds have been added to all locations for a more immersive experience. This is just the first pass, and we will continue improving the soundscape in future patches.
 We have improved the save system. We can now add new quests to old save files. This took a lot of QA work to make sure nothing breaks for existing players.
 Now the most curious players can find two tiny secret locations with generous loot hidden in there.
 We made a lot of small tweaks to many aspects of the game. For example, in some dungeons it was possible to see through walls from certain angles, this has now been fixed. Such small problems interfere with immersion in the game, and we strive to get rid of them in a timely manner.


Thank you, and stay tuned for more news regarding upcoming updates.

notes.title: Important Patch 1.0.80
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! During the last few days we've been working hard to solve every issue our players have encountered. This patch should fix most known bugs as well as improve some quests for better experience.

- A new repeatable quest with a bunch of new sex animations has been added, and can be accessed next to the cave after the the scared merchant quest. Currently works for New Saves only.
- The quest item in the Cheese quest is now easier to spot for the new players.
- It should be easier to find the solution for the cube puzzle in the Old Forest.
- A new thirsty client appear right in the beginning, allowing the new players to get a taste of what's coming.
- We've added colors to the city to help with navigation a bit.
- In certain circumstances, the players could activate the same quest item twice; it should not be possible now.
- We've added a new trigger to make absolutely sure the players can always interact with the door in the Old Forest.
- SteamVR should no longer launch when the game is opening.
- The carrot scene is now shorter to keep it funny, not obnoxious.
- We've removed film grain from the post-processing as it can cause blurry image on certain screens.
- There was an issue with the New Game function when it didn't fully clean the quest log from the previous playthrough, it should do it correctly now.
- A few new hints will display while adventuring in the Old Forest to remind players about the "M" hotkey that creates a beam of light over the cave leading back to the town.
- A number of insignificant bugs were addressed as well as a few gameplay tweaks were made.

Known issues: we are still investigating an issue that causes issues with quest markers on 4k screens. Temporary solution is to lower screen resolution to 1440p in the game's options.

Thank you, and have fun playing Stripped of Title!
